Consider the following statements regarding the advantages of e-Tendering over conventional physical paper tendering:
A. It increases transparency by eliminating physical collusion among contractors at bid submission points.
B. It enables worldwide participation of qualified vendors.
C. It eliminates the need for maintaining digital records or audit trails.

questions.explanation_english: Electronic tendering offers distinct advantages over physical paper tendering by removing physical interface barriers, thereby preventing local supplier cartels and bid suppression. Furthermore, e-tendering platforms automatically maintain comprehensive digital records and immutable audit logs, ensuring that historical records are preserved for transparent administrative and financial auditing purposes.

questions.question_english: Which mechanism is provided on GeM to allow buyers to select items when goods exceed Rs. 500,000 in value?

Online Bidding or Reverse Auction (RA)
Physical cash negotiation conducted directly at the government treasury

Buyers are required to conduct competitive online bidding or reverse auctions on the portal. This process ensures competitive price discovery among qualified sellers, prevents procurement bias, and maintains procedural transparency for substantial public financial transactions across institutions.

questions.explanation_english: The Centralized Public Grievance Redress and Monitoring System is an online platform established to facilitate citizen-centric governance. questions.question_english: What percentage range of the estimated contract value is typically required as Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) under standard public procurement rules?
questions.explanation_english: Public procurement rules under the General Financial Rules stipulate that Earnest Money Deposit amounts generally range between two percent and five percent of the estimated total contract value. Procuring entities fix this monetary threshold based on contract scope and financial risk. The deposit acts as a safeguard against frivolous bidding while ensuring that interested vendors maintain serious commitment throughout the tender evaluation process.
